spec.description:
SECOND SANDBOX (rep 2). Prepare — but do NOT run — the deployment setup for a NEW small backend on our sandbox VM, reusing the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses. Deliver the deploy SETUP ONLY; do not deploy now.

WHAT 'same approach' means (mirrored from revealer-6978): the deterministic shared deploy engine shared/infra/deploy_changes.py configured by a per-project delta config (deploy/<project>.config.sh + deploy/deploy-config.json) that only holds project-specific values; firewall/connectivity handled automatically (control plane refreshes ufw/NSG port 22 to the owner's current single IP; 80/443 stay open); rsync over SSH as user mostafa (never root); sandbox-isolated — OWN folder, OWN database/data, NO domain, NO nginx changes, internal port only, and it MUST NEVER touch bendcore/organics or any production app, DB, config, nginx, or external ports.

DIFFERENCE FROM REVEALER (the one explicit change): this project must NOT run database migrations on every deploy — set migration mode to 'none' (CFG_BACKEND_MIG="none" / "migration":"none"), so no migrate step runs on any deploy.

OWN FOLDER + PORT: this backend uses its OWN folder (separate from revealer-sandbox) and listens on PORT 4200. Target host 52.180.154.225, user mostafa, reboot false, sandbox true, domain null. Proposed folders (following Revealer's convention — confirm/adjust names): local source /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Consolidated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep2-backend ; VM path /home/mostafa/rep2-sandbox/backend. Backend excludes: .env*, node_modules, dist, logs. Build command mirrors Revealer's backend ('rm -rf dist && npm run build' plus its seed step if the new backend has one) — adjust to the new backend's actual build once its code exists. Single backend target only (no frontend target, unlike Revealer which also has one).

DELIVERABLE: the generated deploy/<project>.config.sh and deploy/deploy-config.json for this project, wired to the shared engine, with migration=none, port 4200, own local+VM folders, sandbox safety notes — ready to run later. DO NOT execute a deploy in this step.
